name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 51 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-10-31, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
